meta.name: obsidian-vault
meta.description: Search, create, and manage notes in the Obsidian vault with wikilinks and index notes. Use when user wants to find, create, or organize notes in Obsidian.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 在 Obsidian 中搜索、创建和管理笔记
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你使用 Obsidian 管理笔记并希望自动化操作
copy.tagline_en: Search, create, and manage notes in Obsidian
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you use Obsidian for note-taking and want to automate tasks

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 可以搜索、创建和管理 Obsidian 笔记，使用维基链接和索引笔记来组织内容。
howto.when: 当用户要求查找、创建或整理 Obsidian 笔记时触发。

say.text: 创建一个新笔记，标题为“Transformer 架构”。
say.note: Claude 会按命名规范创建笔记，并添加相关链接。
Claude 会搜索文件名包含“Index”的笔记。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can search, create, and manage notes in the Obsidian vault using wikilinks and index notes for organization.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user wants to find, create, or organize notes in Obsidian.

say_en.note: Claude will search filenames or content for 'RAG'.

say_en.text: Create a new note titled 'Transformer Architecture'.
say_en.note: Claude will create the note with proper naming and links.
Claude will search for filenames containing 'Index'.
